notes.title: "Noel the Mortal Fate" Season FINAL Part 2&Season 3.5 on July 7 at 16:00 JST!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32789618/d8709ee35ab2ef08b68eed1edd0522b754d8a7b4.png[/img]

[h1]"Noel the Mortal Fate Season FINAL Part 2" will be released on July 7 at 16:00 JST.[/h1]
The final episode, which will finally be completed, will be available.

The battle for the future of Laplace finally comes to a head!
Fugo takes on his nemesis, Dratton, while Noel and Caron go head-to-head with Burrows.
What will they see at the end of their revenge?

■Key Points of "Season FINAL Part 2"
1）Fugo goes to his former home, the Dressel abandoned steel mill, as a diversion. Take control of Fugo and carry out the mission to set it on fire.
2）Once again, the game is equipped with a branching system that changes the storyline depending on the choices made.
3）Noel and Caron cornered Burrows on the rooftop of City Hall. Let's win a fierce battle worthy of the last and see how it ends.

▼Check here
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2473440/_Season_Final/


[h1]Noel the Mortal Fate Season 3.5" will also be released on the same day.[/h1]
Season 3.5, previously only available on Nintendo Switch, will be released on July 7 at 16:00 JST.
This work is the story between the "Jillian" and "Burrows" editions.

■Key Points of "Season 3.5"
1）Noel is tired of fighting, so Caron proposes a seven-day break. Explore the slums where the "safe house" is located at your leisure.
2）In the slum, you can enjoy various activities such as visiting cat cafes and restaurants, working part-time, and challenging "back alley missions.
3）Let's proceed with the investigation to find the owner of the "safe house" while talking with the residents of the slum.

▼Check here
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2476120/_S35/

notes.title: Noel the Mortal Fate, new English and Chinese translations have been updated!
notes.content:
Dear fans,

We are proud to announce that the new and improved translations for Noel the Mortal Fate are now live on Steam!
Seasons 1-3 have been updated today, 11/25/2020. Regarding Seasons 4-7, the translations will be rolled out after the 26th over a period of around 2 weeks. The Autumn Sale is currently on so this is a great opportunity to pick up the title.

[h3]被虐のノエル[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/850000/


[h1][b]With a fully revamped translation,
experience Noel the Mortal Fate in its truest form[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32789618/08bf72d1aa6037983ef9ee45b25e85fb05e6d36a.png[/img]
Noel the Mortal Fate is an adventure game that has been steadily gaining in popularity since its serialization in Game Magazine began in 2016. Also seeing both a comic version and a novelization, it has sold over 310,000 copies and in 2019 was even made into a “drama CD” featuring a selection of famous voice actors. Additionally, releases for the Nintendo Switch, PS4, and Xbox One consoles are also currently in the works. These newly improved translations will help give players an even deeper look into the mind of creator Kanawo, and are even more faithful to the original Japanese text. Fans throughout the world will finally be able to experience Noel the Mortal Fate in its truest form.


[h2]An epic, character-driven story of revenge
An ensemble drama led by a young girl and a demon[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32789618/4ca357721150680ffd8614d54abcf535cd43f8a8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32789618/47190e75e33d782e24dbea0bca2170cb185dc4be.jpg[/img]
While the previously-announced console releases of this new translation are being prepared, Game Magazine is taking this opportunity to further enhance the overseas expansion of Noel The Mortal Fate.
Noel The Mortal Fate is the story of Noel Cerquetti, the young daughter of professional pianists who swears revenge on Mayor Burrows for entrapping her, and joins forces with the great devil Caron. As they plot their revenge against the mayor, the pair encounters an eclectic and unique cast of both friends and foes, and engages in a number of exciting battles and quirky missions.
Each episode in Seasons 1~7 features a variety of characters, each with their own plans and personalities which intertwine with the epic storyline, as well as a whole slew of other game features such as casinos, strategy simulations, and hardcore battles.


[h2]Featuring action-packed battles and a deeply engrossing story![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32789618/3df51606ac73d96d7e70fcedf78623433bff6060.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32789618/d0f681d609b030f1186b1bea26c22c0f34c2b2a9.png[/img]
The story features a full cast of unique and interesting enemies and allies. Use your abilities to the fullest to overcome the battles that await you. The ending of each episode will overcome player expectations with the way the story progresses, reminiscent of a Shonen manga, that is sure to stir up your emotions.

Due to last-minute brush-ups and adjustments, the release schedule for S1~S7 has changed.

notes.content:
Hi All 

This is a general notice to all Playism titles. 
From June 14th onwards, I (Cheru) will no longer be Playism's community manager. After over 4 years of working passionately in Playism, I have decided to leave and change direction. Thank you everyone for the amazing communities you have built around Playism games and I hope that you will all continue to enjoy their games for years to come. 

- Cheru

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/6273e7cf103ab31ed7ac54d91f08d9c3df97cda4.gif[/img]

Are you ready for the life-and-death battle that awaits?!

[h1][To everyone who plays from Ver 1.0][/h1]

For those of you who are picking up the game for the first time, here’s a quick introduction as to what sort of awesome title Touhou Luna Nights is.

This game was built in such a way as to fully take advantage of the beautifully rendered sprite animation, the Touhou Project’s “grazing” system which allows for the recovery of HP and MP, and main character Sakuya Izayoi’s power of controlling time and hardcore knife battles.
It also boasts extremely high levels of Metroidvania-style action as you are forced to overcome a wide variety of gimmicks while also taking time to explore the vast map.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/24f5d34423c0e640d35a25c41cc0cfd5c767293e.gif[/img]

After Ver. 1.0, we plan to continue updating the game, with additions such as achievements, Boss Rush, and extra stages in which a certain special someone for whom players have been waiting makes an appearance.

We hope you enjoy the world of Touhou Luna Nights!

notes.title: Noel The Mortal Fate S8 Coming Soon!
notes.content:
We are really excited to announce that Noel The Mortal Fate S8 is coming soon to Steam! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32789618/dd9ae454c6e97439e706b37967720d8390b50db5.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/931670/Noel_The_Mortal_Fate_S8/

[h1]Story[/h1]
Two months after the fateful battle of life and death against Burrows, winter has come to LaPlace...

The counter-terrorism group OCT (Order to Control Terrorism) has been deployed to LaPlace by government order. The uniformed soldiers have taken over the city, which is now permeated with fear and uneasiness.

Far away from civilization, deep in the mountains, Noel and Canon quietly rest their weary bodies. Before them, with the Great Devil Spica in tow, appears Ribelio – an OCT Captain. However, it appears as though Ribelio has gone rogue, acting without the knowledge of the other OCT groups...

Watch the secrets of LaPlace unravel as this all-new season starts!


[h1]Developer Comment[/h1]
As Season 7 wrapped up one large portion of Noel The Mortal Fate, yet another chapter in the series begins anew with Season 8. It's thanks to all the fans out there who requested a continuation that we were able to release this latest localized version of Season 8.
We hope you enjoy this latest storyline in which LaPlace is shaken to its very core by brand-new characters and Noel's designs for revenge.


Noel The Mortal Fate S8 is coming October 22nd on Steam! 
Be sure to add it to your wishlist now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/931670/Noel_The_Mortal_Fate_S8/

notes.title: Noel The Mortal Fate out now on Steam
notes.content:
Noel The Mortal Fate is a charismatic adventure game developed by Kanawo with RPG Maker and serialized in Game Magazine. 

After its success in Japan, Noel The Mortal Fate is now available worldwide on Steam in English and Simplified Chinese. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32789618/73c4b3c3d0666efac3140f0895ac09b6d446a44b.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/850000/Noel_The_Mortal_Fate_S17/ 

[h1]This is a story about the revenge of a girl who lost her arms and legs to a devil…[/h1]

Noel Cerquetti, a girl who lost her arms and legs in a contract, works together with the great devil Caron, to get her revenge against one man.
This man – dubbed the "pride of the citizens" – is Burrows, the mayor of LaPlace.
Why is this girl furiously seeking revenge against this unrivalled man, loved by the people for bringing peace to LaPlace that was once overrun by the mafia?
While unsteady without her limbs, Noel doesn't give up on her path of revenge, as Caron watches mercilessly, at times risking his own life to support her.
With vengeance, the pair begins their chase after Burrows.

[h1]Meet the Characters[/h1]
[b]Noel Cerquetti[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32789618/1171d613d4a1e4c887137e54ffcf050d32a2089e.png[/img]
A girl from the prestigious Cerquetti family whose parents are both pianists. When she didn’t win the top prize at the LaPlace City Piano contest, her pride was hurt, Mayor Burrows tricked her into signing a contract with Caron. The loss of both arms and legs, broke her dream to become a pianist. She has a stubborn and relentless personality, once she makes up her mind, she never changes.


[b]Caron[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32789618/905fbe48f6f8acc191fc90d487d0817fe57fd0bc.png[/img]
Caron the "Great Devil" who has supernatural powers and can fulfil all and any wish. 
He signed a contract with Noel in a demolished building, before realizing it was a trick by Burrows. Caron got angry at Burrows and saved Noel's life, proposing a deal to her. He mostly puts great demands on Noel, but takes care of her, too.


Check out Noel The Mortal Fate S1-7 out now on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/850000/Noel_The_Mortal_Fate_S17/
